latencies.notes: Latency from rj to rd: the value is rotated and merged back, so the narrow rotate takes 2 cycles. A repeated copy closes the chain directly.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: Two alternating copies close the rk chain; the chain_latency carries the second copy, so the latency per instruction is 2 cycles.

latencies.notes: Latency from rk (the rotate amount) to rd: 2 cycles, measured with two alternating copies so the raw cycles are halved.
